sloka: अहं चैव मदीयाश्च सर्वे तव वशानुगाः ।न ते किम्चिदभिप्रायं व्याहन्तुमहमुत्सहे ॥२-१०-३४॥
transliteration: ahaṁ caiva madīyāśca sarve tava vaśānugāḥ ।na te kimcidabhiprāyaṁ vyāhantumahamutsahe ॥2-10-34॥

translations.english: My kins and I are under your control. I will make no effort to go even a little against your wishes.
